data.issue: Brand-name requirement for Palantir Gotham and Foundry and procurement-vehicle standing
data.outcome_summary: GAO dismissed C3.ai's protest because it was not an interested party; GAO later dismissed C3.ai's request for reconsideration
data.significance: Shows recurring vendor-lock-in and procurement-vehicle disputes around installed Palantir platforms
